about: The store layer of proofnotfluff.com (Todd, Oct 22, 2026; seo/STORE.md): the products the home and /shop/ sell, the trade picker on the home page, which paid list each calculator points to, and the refund text. tools/make_site.py reads it; numbers on the cards come from each product's own data file at build time, never from here.
